units: <cite ref="Yoma 28b:2">Yoma 28ᵇ</cite> <he>אי הכי נ׳ ליה טובא</he> (Ms. M. <cite ref="N00128"><he>נַגְהָא</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) if that is so (that it was the time for working men to go to their labors), it must have been bright day-light (sunrise).

<cite ref="Moed Katan 16b:12">M. Kat. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>לא נ׳ לך לישרי לי מר בתיגראי</he> (or <he>בתיגרי</he>, not <he>בתיגריה</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note; Ms. M. <he>נהגא</he> a. differ. version; ed. Ven. <cite ref="N00158"><he>נגיחא</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="N00146"><he>נְגַח</he></cite>) is it (the case you have been thinking of) not yet clear to you? Attend, sir, now to my case (differ. interpret. in Rashi).

senses.gloss: (denom. of נַגְהֵי) to get dark, to be belated.
units: <cite ref="Taanit 24a:3">Taan. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>נ׳ להו וכ׳</he> night set in, and no food was brought to them.
<cite ref="Taanit 24a:3">Ib.</cite> <he>האי דנְגַהְנָא</he> (differ. in Ms. M.) the reason why I am late.
Sabb. 10ᵃ נ׳ לצלויי the time for the evening prayer arrived (Rashi: he delayed).—[Y. Dem. II, 22ᶜ נגיהין, read: נְהִיגִין.]
<cite ref="Niddah 65b:31">Nidd. 65ᵇ</cite> <he>דמַגְּהֵי ביה טפי וכ׳</he> Var. (v. <cite ref="C00690"><he>גִּיחַ</he></cite>) they protract their negotiations before they sign.
